title: A Boat Trip on the River
text:
Last winter, Lucas decided to explore the jungle in Brazil. He joined a small boat tour on the Amazon River. The guide, Rosa, showed the group many colorful birds. The boat was old, but it was safe and comfortable.

On the third day, the boat stopped near a quiet beach. Lucas saw a large turtle and took a picture of it. Rosa said the turtle was almost extinct, so everyone had to stay quiet. Lucas felt lucky to see such a rare animal.

questions.text: What did Lucas join on the Amazon River?
What did Lucas take a picture of?
Why did Rosa ask the group to stay quiet?
options: A rare animal was nearby and could be scared
She wanted to start a story

questions.text: How did Lucas probably feel at the end of the day?
options: Bored and tired of the trip

vocabulary.definition: to travel through a place in order to discover what it is like
pleasant and relaxing to be in or use
not seen or found very often
a person who shows travelers around a place and explains it

paragraph_translations: No inverno passado, Lucas decidiu explorar a selva no Brasil. Ele entrou em um pequeno passeio de barco pelo rio Amazonas. A guia, Rosa, mostrou ao grupo muitos pássaros coloridos. O barco era velho, mas era seguro e confortável.

No terceiro dia, o barco parou perto de uma praia tranquila. Lucas viu uma tartaruga grande e tirou uma foto dela. Rosa disse que a tartaruga estava quase extinta, então todos deveriam ficar em silêncio. Lucas se sentiu sortudo por ver um animal tão raro.
